lead_instructor.heading: Lead Instructor
lead_instructor.name: Dru Hillyard
lead_instructor.bio: Dru is a Black Belt under Prof. Dan Guillemette and Prof. Steve Burgess and has been studying Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu (BJJ) for over 15+ years. To date Dru has over 8 years experience instructing BJJ not to mention many more years of experience as an instructor in the Canadian Armed Forces.
